title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. Can zakaat be given to a child whose parents are not muslims? Is there a difference between a small child and a child who has understanding? 2329 views Q. A man has asset valuing 10 million rupees, this includes his house, car and personal belongings. Alongside he has a debt of 4 million rupees. Is he allow to take zakaat? If yes, how much can he take? 2028 views Q. Can Zakah be paid in form of ration? 8404 views Q. Can we give the interest money from saving accounts to poor relatives? 2530 views Q. Government Tax should be zakah or not? 2623 views Q. As Salaam Mu Alaykum Wa Rahmatullah, Say someone was gifted two pieces of land for their wedding. Two years have pasted. Now they have decided that they will Insha Allah sell one of those lands by the end of the year. As for the other land, nothing has been thought of. Does Zakah have to be given on the lands? If yes how about the past two years when it was not given? Can you, also, please tell me when Zakat should be given on land. Jazak-kumullahu Khair Was salaam 1648 views Q. I have gold from last year Ramadan and I bought more gold 2 months ago. Is it included in zakah with old gold and I saved some cash money as well 3 months ago will this be included as well? 6052 views Q. Can sadqa be used for construction of mosque? 2045 views Q. I have bought a land in the year 2001 for investment purpose. My intention was to sell it and utilize its money for the purpose of building our house whenever we plan to have one since we don?t have our own house yet and are still renting it from outside. Later on, I bought a land and am now building my house on it without selling out the previous land. Now, I have changed my plan to sell that plot and have decided to keep it until, either I decide to sell it or do some sort of business on it. I want to know, (1) Do I have to pay zakat on this land that I bought with the intention to sell and have not sold yet. (2) If so, since when? (3) At what rate per square unit? Kindly advise. 1951 views Q. Advance Zakat 1938 views Q. Can zakaat be given to a Sayyid relative 2649 views Q. Paying Zakat to divorced sister staying with me 3658 views Q. Zakat on land 1770 views Q. I am a student and I don't earn my money yet. So the money I have is my parents. Can I give charity out of that money? 3131 views Q. I need some guidance regarding how to calculate zakaat on my bank account. I calculate my Zakaat every year on the next day of Eid ul Fitr. Should I calculate Zakaat on: the amount that I have in my bank account on the day I am calculating zakaat? OR The amount that stayed in my account for the whole lunar year (in other words, the minimum balance in my account during that lunar year)? I ask this question because the balance in my account keeps changing throughout the year. I would appreciate your help on this matter. 2174 views
answer: Prayers & Duties >> Zakat & Charity Question ID: 66492 Country: Pakistan Title: Zakat on the withdrawl provident fund Question: I have recently withdraw the provident fund from my company. I got the cumulative amount (my contribution as well as the company contribution). I want to know that how should I pay zakah on it, considering the amount I got is more than the nisab. Do I have to pay zakah as soon as I receive money or should that money has to be under my possession for the next 1 year? Answer ID: 66492 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 759/660/D=10/1437) If you are already sahib-e-nisab then when the year completes and zakah becomes wajib on you, you will have to pay the zakah of your PF at that time, it is not necessary to complete one year on PF separately. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
